title: Swipe Right (Ugly Pepper)
description:
**Category:** Poster Design, Social Design

A series of posters addressing food waste caused by the appearance of fruits and vegetables. Large quantities of perfectly edible produce are discarded because of unusual shapes, imperfections, or failure to meet aesthetic standards. Even single bananas are often overlooked by shoppers.

The posters compare choosing fruits and vegetables in a supermarket to choosing a romantic partner on Tinder. Through this visual metaphor, the produce is personified as individuals looking for love and acceptance. Like people, they want to be chosen, appreciated, and needed, regardless of their appearance.

The series questions how much importance we place on looks and reminds us that what truly matters is on the inside.
